verdict.rationale: Phaser's docs describe a runtime Loader that fetches images, atlases, sprite sheets, audio, and JSON at game-start (phaser-docs-10, phaser-docs-36, phaser-docs-47), but this is asset loading inside the game, not an automated import pipeline with hooks, presets, or scripts for preprocessing incoming art assets before they enter the project. No evidence of a CLI/build-time asset pipeline, texture-packing automation, or preset-driven import hooks exists in the pack.
